summary: Tall floor lamp and slender accent table present minor tip-over risks in the living space.

hazards.title: Slender Floor Lamp Tip Risk
hazards.detail: Tall top-heavy metal floor lamp can tip over if bumped by pets or people.
fixSteps: Position lamp base closer against the wall corner
Secure the lamp base with a discreet floor weight or bracket

hazards.title: Fragile Tall Glass Vase
hazards.detail: Tall glass vase on a narrow pedestal table is prone to tipping and shattering.
fixSteps: Secure the vase base using clear museum putty
Move glass vase to a broader, low-traffic surface

hazards.title: Loose Lamp Power Cord
hazards.detail: Floor lamp power cord sits exposed across the base on bare wood floor.
fixSteps: Tuck cord flush against the wall baseboard
Fasten cord along baseboard with adhesive clips

products.reason: Prevents glass vase from toppling off narrow accent table.
